title: Name the acceptance basis distinctly from the work revision in conflict diagnostics
outcome: Name the acceptance basis distinctly from the work revision in conflict diagnostics
acceptance: A refusal or conflict caused by a stale acceptance basis names the acceptance basis (and its expected and current values) rather than the general work revision, and a refusal caused by a stale work revision still names work_revision
A behaviour test triggers each case through the public words and observes the distinct field names
